knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
###Simulating CAR 2#######
NewCAR2 <- function(a1, a2, b0, N, K, noise, Y0 = 0, Y1 = 0)
{
  h <- 1 / K
  
  Y <- numeric(N * K + 100000)
  
  Y[1] <- Y0
  Y[2] <- Y1
  
  for(i in 2:(length(Y)-1))
  {
    Y[i+1] <-
      2 * Y[i] -
      Y[i-1] -
      a1 * h * (Y[i] - Y[i-1]) -
      a2 * h^2 * Y[i] +
      b0 * noise[i] * h
  }
  
  Y[100001:length(Y)]
}

# Parameters
N = 100
K = 10000
M = 500
sigma = 1
mu = 5
eta = 1
Y0 <- 0
Y1 <- 0
a1 = 2
a2 = 0.5
b0 = 1
R=400
alpha=0.05
counter=0;
quantile=qnorm(1-alpha/2);
a <- 1
b <- 2
```

```{r}
recovSingleInt <- function(Y, N, M, a1, a2) {
  Lhat <- numeric(N - 1);
  for (n in 1:(N - 1)) {
    down <- (n-1) * M + 1;
    up <- down + M;
    a <- M * (Y[up] - Y[up + 1] - Y[down] + Y[down + 1])
    b <- a1 * (Y[up] - Y[down])
    c <- a2 * (1 / M) * (sum(Y[(down + 1):(up - 1)]) + (Y[up] + Y[down]) / 2)
    Lhat[n] <- a + b + c
  }
  out <- Lhat
}
```

```{r}
##Z <- rnorm(N*K + 100000, mean = mu*(1/K), sd = sigma*sqrt(1/K))
Z <- rgamma(N * K + 100000, a / K, b)
Y <- NewCAR2(a1, a2, b0, N, K, Z)
relation <- K / M

sample_index <- seq(
  1,
  length(Y),
  by = relation
)
ysample <- Y[sample_index]
TrueIncrements <- function(Z, N, K, burn = 100000) {
  Zf <- Z[(burn + 1):length(Z)]
  cs <- c(0, cumsum(Zf))
  n  <- 2:N
  lo <- (n - 1) * K + 1
  hi <-  n      * K
  cs[hi + 1] - cs[lo]          
}
Lhat <- recovSingleInt(ysample, N, M, a1, a2)
true <- TrueIncrements(Z, N, K)
plot.ts(Lhat)
plot.ts(true)
print(cor(Lhat[3:(N-1)], true[1:(N-3)]))
timeVector = seq(1, (N-3), by = 1)
trues <- true[1:(N-3)]
Lhats <- Lhat[3:(N-1)]
mean(Lhats)
plot(Lhat[3:(N - 1)] - true[1:(N-3)] ~ timeVector)
df <- data.frame(trues, Lhats, timeVector)
ggplot(data = df) + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = trues), color = "darkblue") + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, 
                                                                                               y = Lhats))

```
##ACF###
```{r}
counter = 0;
R = 400;
for (i in 1:R) {
  Z <- rnorm(N*K + 100000, mean = mu*(1/K), sd = sigma*sqrt(1/K)); ##for brownian
  ##Z <- rgamma(N * K + 100000, a / K, b) ##for gamma
  Y <- NewCAR2(a1, a2, b0, N, K, Z);
  ysample <- Y[sample_index];
  NewLhat <- recovSingleInt(ysample, N, M, a1, a2);
  NewLhat <- NewLhat[3:99]
  meanVector[i] <- mean(NewLhat);
  acf(na.omit(NewLhat), plot = FALSE)[2]
  NewL<-na.omit(NewLhat);
  a_1L=acf(NewL, plot = FALSE);
  if(abs(sqrt(N)*a_1L$acf[2])>quantile){counter=counter+1};
}
print(counter / R)
```
